descriptionChirho: Qal: to blow or breathe upon something, as wind upon a fire or God breathing life into man
Qal: to breathe one's last, to expire or give up the ghost
Qal passive participle: blown upon by bellows, resulting in being heated or boiling, said of a pot or furnace
Hifil: to sniff at something with contempt or disdain, to blow at dismissively
Hifil causative: to cause something to breathe out or expire, to make cease
Pual passive: blown upon or kindled, said of a fire that has been fanned by bellows
